verdict.rationale: Ramp documents vendor bill pay end to end, from invoice capture and approval through payment, with a selectable payment method via API. Its Treasury page promises "unlimited free same-day ACH and international wires for bill payments," and RTP instant vendor payments are also listed. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of domestic (not just international) wire payments to vendors, and independent or hands-on corroboration of ACH/wire vendor payouts.
